description: This file defines the IGoogleCast interface and related nested classes and enums for managing Google Cast functionality, including runtime management, status reporting, and event notifications within the WPEFramework namespace.

classes.name: IGoogleCast
classes.description: Interface for Google Cast management, including runtime control, status, and notifications.

classes.name: IGoogleCast::CastStatus
classes.description: Structure representing the current status of the Cast shell, including build number and state.

classes.name: IGoogleCast::IRuntimeManagerDelegate
classes.description: Interface for managing runtime actions such as start, stop, and send to background, with delegate notifications.

classes.name: IGoogleCast::IRuntimeManagerDelegate::Intent
classes.description: Structure representing an intent to launch, close, or destroy a runtime.

classes.name: IGoogleCast::IRuntimeManagerDelegate::IntentContext
classes.description: Structure containing the source of the intent.

classes.name: IGoogleCast::INotification
classes.description: Interface for receiving notifications about Google Cast status changes and intent events.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification sink for Google Cast events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification sink for Google Cast events.

methods.name: GetCastStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of the Cast shell.
